from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs/task-53f19413.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each non-background rectangular board is tiled by the seed at its top-left;
    # the seed dimensions are the bounding box of its colored cells.
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]!=8 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); stack.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            colored=[(y,x) for y,x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored: continue
            sh=max(y for y,x in colored)-min(y for y,x in colored)+1
            sw=max(x for y,x in colored)-min(x for y,x in colored)+1
            for y in range(r0,r1+1):
                for x in range(c0,c1+1):
                    out[y][x]=grid[r0+(y-r0)%sh][c0+(x-c0)%sw]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
